cohort: 2960 pregnant women and 100 healthy controls (1953 pregnant women included in final analysis)
finding: Most pregnancy outcomes were not significantly different between groups with different 25(OH)D levels, except for higher prevalence of gestational diabetes and preterm delivery in women with high levels of vitamin D.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were not significantly different between groups with different 25(OH)D levels.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
